name: sunny-sunroof-blonde-selfie
image_purpose: Summer-day lifestyle post and car selfie

prompt.project_info: Create a natural vertical UGC car selfie for an approved adult, preserving the blonde half-up waves, white red-trim T-shirt, denim shorts, seatbelt, panoramic sunroof, and urban summer setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult with long blonde slightly tousled waves, half pulled back, fair natural skin, light eyes, minimal makeup, soft smile, wearing a white cropped T-shirt with red collar and sleeve cuffs, supplied red printed text, and light-blue denim shorts. A black seatbelt crosses the chest.
prompt.composition_elements: Half-body selfie from the front passenger area, arm extended toward the camera, eye-level slightly angled framing. Include clean modern black car interior, visible seatbelt, large panoramic sunroof with clear blue sky, urban buildings through the windows, and a softly visible background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even natural sunlight entering through the sunroof and windows, airy warm color, realistic skin texture, friendly carefree summer-day mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic wide-angle smartphone selfie, vertical 9:16, sharp face and upper body, visible but gently softened background, natural colors and subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 wide-angle UGC selfie of an approved adult with long blonde slightly tousled waves half pulled back, fair natural skin, light eyes, minimal makeup, and a soft smile. She wears a white cropped T-shirt with red collar and sleeve cuffs, the supplied red printed text, and light-blue denim shorts, with a black seatbelt across the chest. Seated in a clean modern black car beneath a large panoramic sunroof, clear blue sky above, urban buildings through the windows, arm extended toward the camera, bright even natural sunlight, airy warm colors, friendly carefree summer-day mood, realistic smartphone perspective.
